installedRecovery.scope: Installed VSIX in Production extension mode across six separate VS Code launches. The first phase observes actual native Webview boot, graph/navigation messages and close/reopen without replacing its HTML/CSP or JS. Remaining recovery operations call the validated host dispatcher directly. A pending approval survives the first window exit; a managed file transaction continues after the extension host is killed. This is not pointer/keyboard UI automation, visual verification, managed-worker crash recovery, or model-quality evidence.
installedRecovery.provider: Explicit deterministic local stdio fixture; no external AI inference or credentials used.
installedRecovery.dependencyEnvironment: Synthetic repository outside the host checkout with no third-party dependencies. Checks use Node's built-in test runner through the real package-manager verification path.
